abilities.name: Eclipse Fervor
abilities.rawDescription:
Each round: 25% chance to apply Panic to 1 enemy within adjacency for 2 rounds. Panic deals Tactical Damage each round at a +20% Damage Rate. Panic stat scaling and mitigation are not stated.

Rounds 4, 7, 9, and 10: deal Physical Damage to 2 enemies within adjacency at a +80% Damage Rate, scaling with Strength and mitigated by target Instinct.

At 10 Stars, Event Horizon augments Eclipse Fervor on Round 9 with an additional Physical and Tactical attack against the same group of 3 enemies in any lane. The rate for each type comes from Event Horizon. Direct Physical Damage scales with Strength; direct Tactical Damage scales with Instinct. The base Round 9 Physical attack remains and target-group overlap is unresolved.

abilities.name: Warrior's Zeal
abilities.rawDescription: At Dragon Level 16+ while Shadowrend is Vanguard: increase Shadowrend's Physical Damage from Active Commands and Habits by +16%. Increase Instinct and Initiative of the same Left Flank ally by +20 each. The self Physical boost excludes Basic Attacks.

abilities.name: Midnight Aura
abilities.rawDescription:
At the start of rounds 7, 8, 9, and 10: increase Strength and Instinct of the same 3 Allies in any lane, including Shadowrend, until end of the current round. Both are enhanced by Shadowrend's Initiative.

Progression (Strength and Instinct): Habit Level 1: +40%; Level 2: +48%; Level 3: +56%; Level 4: +68%; Level 5: +80%.

Power: 250 / 550 / 900 / 1300 / 1800

abilities.name: Nimble Resilience
abilities.rawDescription:
Start of combat until end: reduce Shadowrend Damage Received and increase Shadowrend Initiative. Self-only.

Progression: Habit Level 1: Damage Received -4%, Initiative +5%; Level 2: -4.8%, +6%; Level 3: -5.6%, +7%; Level 4: -6.8%, +8.5%; Level 5: -8%, +10%.

Power: 250 / 550 / 900 / 1300 / 1800

abilities.name: Fueled by Darkness
abilities.rawDescription:
Each round: one activation roll grants Advantage (+10%) to exactly 2 Allies in any lane for 2 rounds. All three formation members, including Shadowrend, are eligible; recipient selection is unresolved. During Midnight Aura on rounds 7–10, the activation chance is doubled from the current upgraded base chance. The exact meaning of Advantage +10% is unresolved.

Progression (base / during Midnight Aura): Habit Level 1: 10% / 20%; Level 2: 12% / 24%; Level 3: 14% / 28%; Level 4: 17% / 34%; Level 5: 20% / 40%.

Power: 250 / 550 / 900 / 1300 / 1800

abilities.name: Midnight Mastery
abilities.rawDescription:
At the start of rounds 7, 8, 9, and 10: increase Physical and Tactical Damage Dealt by the same 3 Allies, including Shadowrend, until end of the current round.

Progression (Physical and Tactical Damage Dealt): Habit Level 1: +7%; Level 2: +8.4%; Level 3: +9.8%; Level 4: +11.9%; Level 5: +14%.

Power: 250 / 550 / 900 / 1300 / 1800

abilities.name: Event Horizon
abilities.rawDescription:
Augments Eclipse Fervor on Round 9 with one additional attack that deals Physical and Tactical Damage to the same group of 3 enemies in any lane. The base Round 9 Physical attack remains.

Progression (rate per type): Habit Level 1: +100%; Level 2: +130%; Level 3: +160%; Level 4: +200%; Level 5: +250%.

Power: 250 / 580 / 1000 / 1600 / 2300
